evals.prompt: I want a subagent that reviews our terraform changes for security problems and reports back. It should not be able to change anything.
evals.expected_output: An agent markdown file with a read-only tool grant and a description written for delegation.
expectations: An agent markdown file with a read-only tool grant and a description written for delegation.

evals.prompt: My code-auditor agent exists but Claude never delegates to it, it just does the review inline. Fix that.
evals.expected_output: A revised description with a deliverable clause and delegation-oriented phrasing, plus example blocks.
expectations: A revised description with a deliverable clause and delegation-oriented phrasing, plus example blocks.

evals.prompt: This agent has every tool available and its job is just to summarize test output. Tighten it up.
evals.expected_output: A narrowed tools grant justified against what the system prompt actually needs.
expectations: A narrowed tools grant justified against what the system prompt actually needs.

evals.prompt: I set permissionMode on my agent to keep it safe but it does nothing when installed from our plugin. What is going on?
evals.expected_output: An explanation that permissionMode is ignored for plugin subagents, plus the tool-grant alternative.
expectations: An explanation that permissionMode is ignored for plugin subagents, plus the tool-grant alternative.

evals.prompt: Should the flaky-test triage thing be a subagent or a skill? Talk me through it and then build the right one.
evals.expected_output: A reasoned recommendation against the context-window and tool-grant tradeoff, then the corresponding artifact.
expectations: A reasoned recommendation against the context-window and tool-grant tradeoff, then the corresponding artifact.
